Tooltip: Ingests a tabular sheet (one record per row) into the semantic store. Each row becomes one embedded chunk (its row JSON) plus one chunk_fields entry per non-empty cell - exact columns match by string, all other columns are embedded for semantic matching. Safe for multiple machines (file lock + atomic publish). Unchanged documents are skipped entirely on re-runs.

Arguments.Name: in_dt_Sheet
Arguments.Tooltip: The records to ingest, one per row - e.g. from Read Range. Column names become searchable field keys.

Arguments.Name: in_ExactColumns
Arguments.Tooltip: List(Of String) of column names to match EXACTLY at query time (IDs, ranks, codes, numbers) - no embedding is stored for them. Every other column is embedded per value and matched semantically. Include the DocId column here.

Arguments.Name: in_DocIdColumn
Arguments.Tooltip: Name of the column that holds each row's document id. Rows sharing a value belong to one document (deleted + rewritten together). Empty/missing values fall back to '<source>#row<N>'.

Arguments.Name: in_Source
Arguments.Tooltip: Free-text provenance stored on the documents row, e.g. the workbook's full path.

Arguments.Name: in_SharePath
Arguments.Tooltip: Full path of the canonical store.db (usually on a network share). Pulled local before writing; published back atomically (copy + rename) after.

Arguments.Name: in_LocalDbPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Where this machine keeps its local write copy during the ingest, e.g. C:\rag\write\store.db. Created automatically.

Arguments.Name: in_LockPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Path of the write-lock file next to the canonical store, e.g. \\server\share\rag\store.lock. Only one machine can write at a time; the lock is the held file handle, so a crash releases it automatically.

Arguments.Name: in_EmbeddingUrl
Arguments.Tooltip: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (POST .../v1/embeddings). Called in batches: once for all row JSONs, once for all semantic field values.

Arguments.Name: in_ApiKey
Arguments.Tooltip: Bearer token for the embedding endpoint. Leave empty for anonymous endpoints. Source from an Orchestrator Credential asset - never hardcode.

Arguments.Name: in_Model
Arguments.Tooltip: Model name sent to the endpoint, e.g. BAAI/bge-m3. Recorded in the store's meta table; retrieval must use the same model.

Arguments.Name: in_EmbeddingDim
Arguments.Tooltip: Vector length the model returns (bge-m3 = 1024). Writes are rejected if a returned vector has a different length.

Arguments.Name: in_BatchSize
Arguments.Tooltip: Texts per embedding HTTP call. Larger = fewer round-trips; raise if the server handles it (16-64 typical).

Arguments.Name: in_TimeoutSec
Arguments.Tooltip: HTTP timeout per embedding call. Allow headroom for cold model starts (e.g. 120).

Arguments.Name: in_MaxRetries
Arguments.Tooltip: Retries for transient embedding failures (5xx, timeouts, 429). Permanent 4xx errors fail immediately without retrying.

Arguments.Name: in_LockTimeoutMs
Arguments.Tooltip: How long to wait for the write lock if another machine is ingesting. On timeout the run returns gracefully with 'LOCK NOT ACQUIRED' in Errors (no exception).

Arguments.Name: out_RowsWritten
Arguments.Tooltip: Number of rows actually written this run. 0 when every document was unchanged (skipped).

Arguments.Name: out_Errors
Arguments.Tooltip: List(Of String) of failures. Empty on success. 'LOCK NOT ACQUIRED: ...' means another writer held the lock; 'STRUCTURED INGEST ABORTED: ...' means the run failed and the canonical store was NOT modified.
